project_type: SvelteKit 3.1.1 (Svelte 5.57 runes) app with adapter-node; server-side services over Drizzle 0.45/Postgres 18; pure bracket engine in src/lib/brackets
build_system: pnpm 10.28 via corepack (`corepack pnpm <cmd>`; pnpm is not on PATH). Vite 8 + @sveltejs/kit 3.1.1. Zod 4.6.7 (z.toJSONSchema built in; no zod-openapi, no new dependencies). Paraglide compiles messages/en.json into src/lib/paraglide (gitignored) during `check`/build. `#lib/...` subpath imports MUST include the file extension (`#lib/server/db/index.ts`, `#lib/paraglide/messages.js`); relative imports inside a folder omit it (`./errors`). Env vars are declared in src/env.ts and read from `$app/env/private`.
test_framework: Vitest 4 with two projects in vite.config.ts: `server` (src/**/*.spec.ts, pure, NO DATABASE_URL in CI) and `db` (src/**/*.db.spec.ts against TEST_DATABASE_URL tournament_test, schema dropped and re-migrated by src/lib/server/testing/db-setup.ts, files serial, env AUTH_MODULES=dev). `expect.requireAssertions: true`: every test must assert. Anything importing a service, #lib/server/db, api/schemas.ts, api/endpoints.ts or a route module MUST be a *.db.spec.ts (db/index.ts throws at import without DATABASE_URL). Playwright e2e in e2e/*.e2e.ts; webServer runs `node scripts/migrate.js && pnpm build && node build` on :4173 against E2E_DATABASE_URL (tournament_e2e) with AUTH_MODULES=dev, TRUSTED_AUTH_MODULES=dev, ALLOW_DEV_AUTH=true, PROTOCOL_HEADER=x-forwarded-proto; config sets extraHTTPHeaders X-Forwarded-Proto: http for page and request fixtures.
test_command: corepack pnpm test:unit --run   (e2e: $env:PATH = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\corepack-shims;$env:PATH"; corepack pnpm test:e2e)
verification_instructions: 1) corepack pnpm format (also formats .agents/**, which prettier checks). 2) corepack pnpm check -> 0 errors, 0 warnings. 3) corepack pnpm lint (prettier --check . && eslint .). 4) corepack pnpm test:unit --run -> all server + db tests pass (baseline before M7: 24 files / 289 tests). Target a folder with `corepack pnpm test:unit --run src/lib/server/api`. 5) e2e in the SAME shell call: $env:PATH = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\corepack-shims;$env:PATH"; corepack pnpm test:e2e (baseline 9 passed; allow a 20 min timeout; target one file with `corepack pnpm test:e2e e2e/api.e2e.ts`). Schema change: corepack pnpm db:generate --name api_key_messages (if drizzle-kit says DATABASE_URL is not set, prefix $env:DATABASE_URL='postgres://root:mysecretpassword@localhost:5432/local';), then corepack pnpm db:migrate.
snapshot_or_generated_files: drizzle/0004_api_key_messages.sql, drizzle/meta/0004_snapshot.json and the drizzle/meta/_journal.json entry are generated by `corepack pnpm db:generate --name api_key_messages` (FEAT-001) and committed with the schema change; never hand-edit them. src/lib/paraglide is generated and gitignored.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell; each shell call is a fresh session, so env changes (PATH, DATABASE_URL) must be set in the same command. Postgres runs in Docker container tournament-db-1 (healthy); databases local, tournament_test, tournament_e2e exist; if Docker is down run `corepack pnpm db:start` and retry `docker info`. Playwright Chromium is installed; pnpm shims for its webServer are at %LOCALAPPDATA%\corepack-shims (prefix e2e runs with the PATH line above). git core.autocrlf=true (never change git config): if git status ever lists many files ' M' with empty `git diff`, that's line-ending stat noise, never stage those. .env exists and must never be committed. .agents/ is untracked and must never be staged. Do NOT commit in FEAT steps; the single M7 commit happens in the final step. Never push. No new dependencies. Leave the six minor M6 findings in .agents/tasks/m6-match-room/verdict.json alone (scheduled for M8).
contribution_requirements: Match existing style exactly: tabs, single quotes, no trailing commas, printWidth 100 (prettier.config.js); terse doc comments in the existing tone (see services/*.ts, auth/org.ts). Every new UI string goes in messages/en.json (Paraglide `m.key()`); API error messages, OpenAPI summaries/descriptions stay English strings in server code like ServiceError messages. Core rule (docs/PLAN.md): UI form actions and REST endpoints call the same services/* functions; authorization in guards at the edge (requireOrgRole, requireTournamentAdmin, and the new requireApiKey/requireApiTournament in src/lib/server/auth/apiKey.ts); services enforce phase rules and throw ServiceError. Never put business logic in route handlers: if the API needs something, extend the service and use it from both. Zod validates inputs (reuse service schemas: tournamentSchema, messageSchema, matchIdSchema, structureSchema/stageSettingsSchema/stageConfigSchema). Svelte: `let { data }: PageProps = $props()`, `$derived`, `resolve('/route/[param]', params)` from $app/paths for every non-fragment href (eslint svelte/no-navigation-without-resolve; `#fragment` links are allowed), `<style lang="scss">` with `@use 'tokens' as *;` only when breakpoints are needed, CSS custom properties for colors. Migrations generated with drizzle-kit and committed with the schema. Commit message style: 'Add the REST API with OpenAPI spec and docs (M7)' + bullet body + 'Verified: …' line like the M6 commit (git show -s HEAD). docs/PLAN.md: M7 ✅ in the milestones table + '## Implementation notes (M7)' after the M6 notes; README.md gains a '## REST API' section.
key_patterns: Guards throw SvelteKit `error(status, message)` (auth/guards.ts, auth/org.ts, auth/tournament.ts). Services: `db.transaction(async (tx) => …)`; results go through services/matches.ts setMatchResult (by: { userId } | { apiKeyId }) / clearMatchResult / reportResult, which lock the stage (lockStage) and call refreshStage; they publish to events.ts after commit; chat.ts postMessage publishes { type: 'chat', matchId, message }. UI route actions: `const { tournament } = await requireTournamentAdmin(event)`; `try { await service() } catch (e) { if (e instanceof ServiceError) return fail(400, { error: e.message }); throw e; }`. API layer (new): src/lib/server/api/{errors.ts (envelope, pure), openapi.ts (Endpoint type, defineEndpoint, buildOpenApiDocument, pure), schemas.ts (components registry + all registered schemas), responses.ts (to* serializers), handler.ts (endpoint(), methodNotAllowed), endpoints.ts (29 definitions, `endpoints`, `openApiDocument`), reference.ts (docs view model, pure)}; routes import `* as api from '#lib/server/api/endpoints.ts'` and export `GET = endpoint(api.getTournament, async ({ key, params }) => …)` plus `export const fallback = methodNotAllowed;`. Zod 4 facts verified in planning: z.toJSONSchema(registry, { io: 'input', uri: (id) => '#/components/schemas/' + id }) returns { schemas } with $refs between registered schemas and each entry carrying $schema/$id (strip them); field descriptions come from `.describe()` (global registry, default `metadata`), NOT from the custom registry's meta; tuples -> prefixItems; nullable -> anyOf with null; transforms are fine in io 'input'; z.date() is unrepresentable (use z.iso.datetime({ offset: true })). DB tests: beforeEach resetDatabase(), createUser, createOrganization(owner.id, { name, slug, description: '' }), createTournament, addParticipant, setStatus + reload via getTournamentById, startTournament (see services/matches.db.spec.ts `start(n)` helper). e2e: helpers.ts (uniqueName, signIn, createOrganization, createTournament, adminTab, playerPage, registerPlayers); API keys UI: getByLabel('Name', { exact: true }), button 'Create key', testid 'new-api-key', button 'Revoke', text 'No API keys yet.'.
directory_structure: src/lib/brackets (pure engine), src/lib/server/{db,auth,modules,services,testing} (server only; services/* are the shared business layer used by UI actions and the REST API), src/lib/server/api (new: REST API infrastructure and OpenAPI), src/lib/components (Svelte components), src/lib/styles (_tokens.scss, global.scss), src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/ (public tournament pages + admin/ tabs), src/routes/api/v1/ (new: REST endpoints), src/routes/docs/api/ (new: docs page), drizzle/ (SQL migrations + meta snapshots), e2e/ (Playwright), messages/en.json (Paraglide), docs/PLAN.md (roadmap + implementation notes).
